nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in constructor and used by onlyOwner checks.
Pending owner address used by transferOwnership/acceptOwnership two-step handover.
Token symbol string, set to DGM in Dgram constructor.
Token name string, set to 'Dgram Token' in Dgram constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in Dgram constructor.
Total token supply; read, increased by mint and decreased by _burn.
Mapping of holder balances, mutated by transfer, transferFrom, mint and _burn.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount, written by approve and transferFrom.
Flag that permanently disables minting once finishMinting is called.
Hard cap on total supply enforced in mint.
Maximum amount mintable in a single mint call.
SafeMath.add: checked addition c = a + b with require(c >= a).
SafeMath.sub: checked subtraction c = a - b with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.mul: checked multiplication with overflow require.
SafeMath.div: division with require(b > 0).
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: sets pending newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner.
totalSupply() view: returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address) view: returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using SafeMath.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance and moves balance.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Fallback function that reverts on any plain ETH transfer.
onlyOwner rescue that performs an external ERC20 transfer from this contract.
mint(address _to, uint256 _amount): permissioned minting bounded by batchlimits and cap.
finishMinting() onlyOwner canMint: permanently disables minting.
burn(uint256 _value): public entry that burns msg.sender's tokens via _burn.
_burn(address _who, uint256 _value): internal balance destruction updating balances and _totalSupply.
Dgram constructor: initialises symbol, name, decimals, supply, cap, batchlimits and owner balance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed by the Owned constructor that establishes privileged ownership.

_newOwner parameter is stored into newOwner by transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership gates on msg.sender == newOwner before promoting ownership.
acceptOwnership reassigns the owner state variable to newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before transferOwnership body runs.
hasMintPermission modifier compares msg.sender with owner before minting.
onlyOwner modifier guards finishMinting.
onlyOwner modifier guards transferAnyERC20Token.

spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance().
